acceptanceCriteria.text: Search Camps sends captured getCampSummary:camp args {} and populates selectable camps with levels/defenders and respawn time.
Errors and queued transport never count as successful/empty search; expired and defeated camps cannot remain selectable.
Camp search inherits global dispatch settings and works in Piggyback; search itself never spends World Energy.
Tests, typecheck and build pass; docs describe verified discovery protocol.
